messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired: "ap-south.az20 - sudden 5xx surge and kvcache churn". Severity: SEV1. Notified: @tina oncall, PD auto-escalation 90s.

pagerduty-bot: PD alert: ap-south.az20 - elevated 5xx from model-serving pools. Auto-escalate in 90s. :rotating_light:

 tina: ACK. I'm triaging. First check control plane routing & autoscaler events.

 jamie: pulling model metrics. Shard hotspots: model-shard-3 and -4 with eviction spikes; eviction_rate ~110/min on az20.

 luis: node tail from az20-node7:

 ```
 [2026-09-09T09:21:02Z] kvcache: evict shard=3 count=112 mem_frac=0.93
 [2026-09-09T09:21:05Z] serving: upstream error 503 model-shard-3
 [2026-09-09T09:21:07Z] kubelet: OOMKilled container=model-srv-3
 ```

 tina: autopager policy shows fallback candidates az19 & az22. I'd like to divert only az20->az19. Can someone confirm capacity on az19?

 dylan: quick infra check: az19 has ~20% spare serving capacity with prewarmed instances. Az22 less warmed (cold start risk).

 robin: autopager state:

 {"policy":"ap-south-region-fallback","state":"triggered","initiator":"autopager","targets":["az19","az22"]}

 tina: /approve fallback to az19 only. Reason: targeted divert to reduce customer impact while we collect diagnostics.

 incident-bot: Fallback approved by @tina. Initiating weighted reroute to az19 (rolling 25% -> 100% over 45s).

 pagerduty-bot: PD update: traffic divert to az19 initiated by oncall. Escalation paused.

 jamie: watching: az20 5xx rate falling 36% -> 6% within 4m. az19 latency up ~140ms while model caches warm. Expected.

 luis: ran redwoodctl command and attached job id:

 ```
 $ redwoodctl route shift --region ap-south --from az20 --to az19 --duration 45s
 job=route-shift-20260909-0922
 status=accepted
 ```

 maria: CS update: small subset of enterprise tenants reported degraded responses between 09:21-09:29 UTC. Drafting status message.

 maria: posting status -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-09-09-ap-south-az20

 incident-bot: Status page updated by @maria :white_check_mark:

 dylan: autoscaler logs show rapid pod churn in az20 starting ~09:18, correlated with GC spikes in the serving process. Possible memory pressure regression in latest runtime.

 jamie: action items for RCA: capture heap profiles from crashed pods, eviction histograms per shard, git rollouts in serving runtime in last 24h.

 luis: diag bundle uploaded -> s3://redwood-diags/ap-south/2026-09-09-az20-eviction-bundle.tar.gz

 robin: assigning ownership of postmortem to @jamie. Creating ticket INF-5877 and linking diagnostics.

 tina: handing off oncall to @robin; I'll remain available for 1hr. Handoff summary: diverted to az19; error rates improving; diag uploaded; status posted.

 robin: acked, taking over. PD note: incident mitigated for customer impact, keeping SEV1 open until 2h stable. Closing PD ack loop.

 pagerduty-bot: PD status: mitigated by oncall. Auto-escalation suspended. :lock:

 maria: prepping customer follow-ups and offering expedited postmortem to impacted tenants.

 jamie: quick montage of metrics: global ap-south 5xx fell from 22% -> 2% in 6m after divert. Cache warmup cost incurred (~10% CPU uplift).

 robin: summary for record: autopager -> fallback triggered -> approved operator divert az20->az19 -> routing applied -> 5xx decreased -> diagnostics uploaded -> status page updated. Participants: tina, jamie, luis, robin, maria, dylan, pagerduty-bot, incident-bot.

 incident-bot: Thread closed by @robin (oncall). Will reopen on new activity.
